channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Active surveillance proves cost-effective versus surgery for esophageal cancer patients with complete response after chemoradiotherapy
item.description: Over five years, active surveillance was more cost-effective than standard surgery for esophageal cancer patients achieving complete clinical response after neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy.

item.title: Alarming shift in cancer drug approvals noted
item.description: FDA approvals for solid tumor drugs increasingly rely on response rates rather than overall survival as primary evidence, raising concerns.

item.title: New score predicts post-transplant mortality in children
item.description: A novel sepsis score accurately identifies children at highest risk of death after liver transplantation and infection, according to Medscape Medical News.

item.title: Atogepant shows superior migraine prevention over topiramate
item.description: In a phase 3b trial, atogepant demonstrated better tolerability and efficacy than topiramate for migraine prevention, as reported by Medscape Medical News.
